# Technology icons

Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender and Godot SVGs are vendored without modification from [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon/tree/6a37858047b0e8d9c9c0e68f4a071fc410652e89/icons), commit `6a37858047b0e8d9c9c0e68f4a071fc410652e89`. See `DEVICON-LICENSE`.

The SolidWorks PNG is the [official SOLIDWORKS website favicon](https://www.solidworks.com/themes/custom/sw-digital/favicon.ico), retrieved 2026-10-21. The upstream favicon has a PNG payload (54 x 53), saved here with a matching .png extension without image modification.

Logos identify the software listed in this portfolio. Product names and marks belong to their respective owners. CSS renders the monochrome Unity and Unreal Engine marks in white for contrast on the existing dark panel.
